subject: COVID-19 Distance Learning and Student Engagement
overview: The School Committee reviewed extensive data on student engagement and remote learning effectiveness during the COVID-12 pandemic. The body approved a negotiated payment agreement for bus contractors and discussed plans to ensure an in-person graduation for the Class of 2020.

items.title: Minutes and Fund Transfers
items.summary: Approved the minutes of March 6, 2020, and a transfer of funds.

items.title: Budget Committee of the Whole Report
items.summary: Approved the report from the April 6 meeting regarding departmental line-item budget reviews.

items.title: Special Education and Behavioral Health Subcommittee
items.summary: Approved the subcommittee report which identified trauma and community relationships as primary goals for the academic year.

items.title: Report of the Superintendent
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent announced the official cancellation of MCAS and SAT exams for the year and congratulated librarian Maria Dorsey on receiving the 2020 Super Librarian Award.

items.title: COVID-19 Health Update
items.summary: Health officials reported 519 positive cases in Medford and highlighted the success of the 'RUOK' program in contacting 11,000 seniors for wellness checks.

items.title: Negotiated Transportation Contract Payment
items.summary: Approved a Memorandum of Agreement with Eastern Bus Company to pay 70% of the daily rate during the school closure to ensure bus drivers remain employed and available for a return to service.

items.title: Kindergarten Online Enrollment
items.summary: The district reported that 188 students have registered through a new online enrollment system launched in response to the pandemic.

items.title: Student Engagement and Wellness Checks
items.summary: Reviewed a report indicating that 38 students have had no contact with the district since the closure began, while another 350 students are being monitored for sporadic participation in remote learning.

items.title: Community Roundtables for Fall Scenarios
items.summary: Approved a motion to have the Engagement and Communications subcommittee plan community roundtables in May to discuss various scenarios for returning to school in Fall 2020.

items.title: CPAC Special Education Survey Results
items.summary: The Special Education Parent Advisory Council (CPAC) presented survey data highlighting concerns over academic regression and recommending improved communication from central administration.

items.title: Distance Learning Parent Survey
items.summary: Dr. Peter Cushing presented results from 595 parent responses showing that approximately half of the students are spending two to three hours daily on academics.

items.title: Student Opportunity Act (SOA) Application
items.summary: Referred the Student Opportunity Act application and multi-language survey plan to the Engagement subcommittee for further review.

items.title: Senior Class of 2020 Events
items.summary: The administration affirmed a commitment to holding an in-person graduation for the Class of 2020 and discussed postponing senior activities rather than cancelling them.

items.title: Condolences and Adjournment
items.summary: Recognized several community members and staff with moments of silence before adjourning the meeting.
